/* ===========================================================
   Websitemodel 1 - Admin (FormForge)
   Gebaseerd op de admin van generaalprojecten.nl, maar neutraal:
   alles wat per klant verschilt staat in Instellingen.

   - Eerste bezoek: e-mailadres en wachtwoord instellen (data/config.json)
   - Instellingen (bedrijfsgegevens, teksten, diensten, kleuren, logo): data/settings.json
   - Projecten: data/pages.json, elk project een eigen map /{slug}/index.html
   - Foto's: /uploads/{slug}/, logo: /uploads/site/
   - De admin maakt zelf: index.html, dienstpagina's, /contact/, /bedankt/,
     site.json, sitemap.xml en robots.txt
   - Wachtwoord kwijt: verwijder data/config.json, dan verschijnt het
     instelscherm opnieuw (projecten en instellingen blijven bewaard)
   =========================================================== */

function load_settings() {
    $s = default_settings();
    if (file_exists(SETTINGS_FILE)) {
        $d = json_decode(file_get_contents(SETTINGS_FILE), true);
        if (is_array($d)) { $s = array_merge($s, $d); }
    }
    return $s;
}
function save_settings($s) {
    ensure_data_dir();
    versie_voor('settings', $s);
    file_put_contents(SETTINGS_FILE, json_encode($s, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES), LOCK_EX);
}
$ST = load_settings();

function st($k) { global $ST; return trim((string)($ST[$k] ?? '')); }

/* Actieve diensten: sleutel => gegevens */
function services() {
    global $ST;
    $out = [];
    foreach (($ST['diensten'] ?? []) as $d) {
        if (trim($d['naam'] ?? '') === '' || empty($d['key']) || empty($d['slug'])) continue;
        $out[$d['key']] = $d;
    }
    return $out;
}
function cat_names() {
    $o = [];
    foreach (services() as $k => $d) { $o[$k] = $d['naam']; }
    return $o;
}
function service_url($key) {
    $s = services();
    return isset($s[$key]) ? '/' . $s[$key]['slug'] . '/' : '/#diensten';
}
/* Een link die de klant zelf invult: https://..., /pagina/, #blok, tel: of mailto:. Anders leeg. */
function eigen_link($lnk) {
    $lnk = trim((string)$lnk);
    if ($lnk !== '' && preg_match('#^www\.\S+$#i', $lnk)) { $lnk = 'https://' . $lnk; }
    return preg_match('#^(https?://\S+|/\S*|\#[\w-]+|tel:[+\d ]{6,20}|mailto:\S+@\S+)$#i', $lnk) ? cut($lnk, 300) : '';
}
/* Extra knoppen in het menu (bijvoorbeeld naar eigen pagina's die al op de server staan) */
function menu_links() {
    $uit = [];
    global $ST;
    foreach ((is_array($ST['menulinks'] ?? null) ? $ST['menulinks'] : []) as $x) {
        if (!is_array($x)) continue;
        $t = trim((string)($x['tekst'] ?? '')); $l = eigen_link($x['link'] ?? '');
        if ($t !== '' && $l !== '') { $uit[] = ['tekst' => $t, 'link' => $l]; }
    }
    return array_slice($uit, 0, 6);
}

/* Webadres van de site: uit de instellingen, anders het huidige domein */
function site_url() {
    $u = st('site_url');
    if ($u !== '') return rtrim($u, '/');
    $host = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9.\-:]/', '', (string)($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? 'localhost'));
    $https = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off') || (($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] ?? '') === 'https');
    return ($https ? 'https://' : 'http://') . $host;
}
function tel_link($t) {
    $d = preg_replace('/[^0-9+]/', '', (string)$t);
    if ($d === '') return '';
    if (strpos($d, '00') === 0) return '+' . substr($d, 2);
    if ($d[0] === '0') return '+31' . substr($d, 1);
    return $d;
}
function valid_color($c, $fallback) {
    return preg_match('/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/', (string)$c) ? strtolower($c) : $fallback;
}
function logo_url() {
    $l = st('logo');
    return $l !== '' ? '/uploads/site/' . rawurlencode($l) : '';
}
/* WhatsApp: nummer omzetten naar het internationale formaat voor wa.me */
function whatsapp_nummer() {
    $n = preg_replace('/[^0-9+]/', '', st('whatsapp'));
    if ($n === '') return '';
    if (strpos($n, '+') === 0) { $n = substr($n, 1); }
    elseif (strpos($n, '00') === 0) { $n = substr($n, 2); }
    elseif (strpos($n, '0') === 0) { $n = '31' . substr($n, 1); }
    $n = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $n);
    return strlen($n) >= 9 && strlen($n) <= 15 ? $n : '';
}
function whatsapp_url() {
    $n = whatsapp_nummer();
    if ($n === '') return '';
    $t = st('whatsapp_tekst') !== '' ? st('whatsapp_tekst') : 'Hallo ' . st('naam') . ', ik heb een vraag.';
    return 'https://wa.me/' . $n . '?text=' . rawurlencode($t);
}
function whatsapp_fab() {
    $u = whatsapp_url();
    if ($u === '') return '';
    return '<a class="wafab' . (chat_url() !== '' ? ' hoog' : '') . '" href="' . h($u) . '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Stuur ons een WhatsApp-bericht"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3a9 9 0 0 0-7.8 13.5L3 21l4.6-1.2A9 9 0 1 0 12 3Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M9 8.5c.3 2.6 2.1 4.9 5 6l1.4-1.3-1.8-1.2-.9.7c-1-.5-1.8-1.3-2.3-2.3l.7-.9-1.2-1.8L9 8.5Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg><span>WhatsApp</span></a>'
         . '<style>.wafab{position:fixed;right:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:51;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#25d366;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;line-height:1;padding:12px 18px 12px 14px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.45);font-family:inherit;} .wafab:hover{filter:brightness(1.06);} .wafab svg{width:24px;height:24px;flex:none;} .chatfab{bottom:calc(76px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)) !important;} @media (max-width:520px){.wafab span{display:none;} .wafab{padding:14px;} .foot .wrap{padding-bottom:96px;}} @media print{.wafab{display:none;}}</style>';
}
function chat_url() {
    $c = st('chat_url');
    return preg_match('#^https://#i', $c) ? $c : '';
}

/* ---------- Stijlen van de FormForge-server ----------
   Nieuwe stijlen zet FormForge centraal neer. De admin haalt de lijst
   hooguit twee keer per dag op en bewaart hem. Lukt dat niet, dan gelden
   de laatst opgehaalde stijlen, en anders de vijf ingebouwde. */
define('STIJLEN_CACHE', DATA_DIR . '/stijlen-cache.json');
function stijl_http_get($url) {
    if (function_exists('ff_http_get')) return ff_http_get($url, 5);
    if (function_exists('curl_init')) {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 5, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 5]);
        $b = curl_exec($ch); $code = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE); curl_close($ch);
        return ($b !== false && $code >= 200 && $code < 300) ? $b : null;
    }
    return null;
}
function stijl_schoon($k, $v) {
    if (!preg_match('/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$/', (string)$k) || !is_array($v)) return null;
    $naam = trim((string)($v['naam'] ?? ''));
    if ($naam === '') return null;
    $fonts = (string)($v['fonts'] ?? '');
    if (!preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9+:;,@.&=_ -]{0,400}$/', $fonts)) $fonts = '';
    $css = str_replace(['<', '>'], '', (string)($v['css'] ?? ''));
    if (strlen($css) > 60000) $css = substr($css, 0, 60000);
    return ['naam' => cut($naam, 40), 'tekst' => cut(trim((string)($v['tekst'] ?? '')), 200), 'fonts' => $fonts, 'css' => $css, 'grote_foto' => !empty($v['grote_foto'])];
}
function stijlen_server() {
    static $lijst = null;
    if ($lijst !== null) return $lijst;
    $c = read_json(STIJLEN_CACHE, []);
    $nu = time();
    $vers = isset($c['stijlen']) && $nu - (int)($c['checked'] ?? 0) < 12 * 3600;
    $pas = $nu - (int)($c['tried'] ?? 0) < 900;
    if (!$vers && !$pas) {
        $server = function_exists('licentie_server') ? licentie_server() : 'https://formforge-sync-1.onrender.com';
        $body = stijl_http_get($server . '/api/website/stijlen');
        $d = $body !== null ? json_decode($body, true) : null;
        if (is_array($d) && isset($d['stijlen']) && is_array($d['stijlen'])) {
            $schoon = [];
            foreach ($d['stijlen'] as $k => $v) { $x = stijl_schoon($k, $v); if ($x) $schoon[$k] = $x; }
            $c = ['stijlen' => $schoon, 'checked' => $nu];
        }
        $c['tried'] = $nu;
        if (is_dir(DATA_DIR)) { @file_put_contents(STIJLEN_CACHE, json_encode($c, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES), LOCK_EX); }
    }
    $lijst = [];
    foreach ((array)($c['stijlen'] ?? []) as $k => $v) { $x = stijl_schoon($k, $v); if ($x) $lijst[$k] = $x; }
    return $lijst;
}
/* Alle stijlen: eerst de ingebouwde, aangevuld en eventueel verbeterd door de server */
function alle_stijlen() {
    global $STIJLEN;
    $uit = [];
    foreach ($STIJLEN as $k => $v) {
        $ib = stijl_css_ingebouwd($k);
        $uit[$k] = ['naam' => $v['naam'], 'tekst' => $v['tekst'], 'fonts' => $ib['fonts'], 'css' => $ib['css'], 'grote_foto' => $k === 'etalage'];
    }
    foreach (stijlen_server() as $k => $v) { $uit[$k] = $v; }
    return $uit;
}
function stijl() {
    $alle = alle_stijlen();
    $s = st('stijl');
    return isset($alle[$s]) ? $s : 'stoer';
}
function stijl_css($s) {
    $alle = alle_stijlen();
    if (!isset($alle[$s]) || trim($alle[$s]['css']) === '') return '';
    $link = $alle[$s]['fonts'] !== '' ? '<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?' . h($alle[$s]['fonts']) . '&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />' . "\n" : '';
    return $link . "<style>\n/* stijl: " . $s . " */\n" . $alle[$s]['css'] . "\n</style>\n";
}
function stijl_grote_foto() {
    $alle = alle_stijlen();
    $s = stijl();
    return !empty($alle[$s]['grote_foto']);
}

function beweging() { global $BEWEGINGEN; $b = st('beweging'); return isset($BEWEGINGEN[$b]) ? $b : ''; }
/* Eigen video bovenaan: een korte film (max 10 seconden) die steeds opnieuw speelt */
function eigen_video() {
    if (st('beweging') !== 'eigenvideo' || st('video') === '') return '';
    $f = basename(st('video'));
    return is_file(UPLOAD_DIR . '/site/' . $f) ? $f : '';
}
function ini_naar_bytes($v) {
    $v = trim((string)$v); if ($v === '') return 0;
    $n = (float)$v;
    switch (strtolower(substr($v, -1))) { case 'g': $n *= 1024; case 'm': $n *= 1024; case 'k': $n *= 1024; }
    return (int)$n;
}
/* Grootste video die hier past: onze grens, of kleiner als de server minder toestaat */
function video_max_bytes() {
    $m = MAX_VIDEO_BYTES;
    $u = ini_naar_bytes(ini_get('upload_max_filesize')); if ($u > 0 && $u < $m) $m = $u;
    $p = ini_naar_bytes(ini_get('post_max_size')); if ($p > 0 && $p - 2 * 1024 * 1024 < $m) $m = max(1024 * 1024, $p - 2 * 1024 * 1024);
    return $m;
}
function mb_tekst($b) { return rtrim(rtrim(number_format($b / 1048576, 1, ',', ''), '0'), ',') . ' MB'; }
/* Een mp4 of mov bekijken: is het echt een video, hoe lang duurt hij en kan elke browser hem afspelen?
   Geeft ['ok' => bool, 'duur' => seconden (0 = onbekend), 'fout' => tekst]. */
function mp4_info($pad) {
    $f = @fopen($pad, 'rb');
    if (!$f) return ['ok' => false, 'duur' => 0, 'fout' => 'Het bestand kon niet worden gelezen.'];
    $eind = filesize($pad);
    $zoek = function($start, $stop, $naam) use ($f) {
        $q = $start;
        while ($q + 8 <= $stop) {
            fseek($f, $q); $kop = fread($f, 8);
            if (strlen($kop) < 8) return null;
            $u = unpack('Ngrootte/a4soort', $kop);
            $gr = $u['grootte']; $kl = 8;
            if ($gr === 1) { $x = unpack('Nhoog/Nlaag', fread($f, 8)); $gr = $x['hoog'] * 4294967296 + $x['laag']; $kl = 16; }
            elseif ($gr === 0) { $gr = $stop - $q; }
            if ($gr < $kl) return null;
            if ($u['soort'] === $naam) return [$q + $kl, min($stop, $q + $gr)];
            $q += $gr;
        }
        return null;
    };
    fseek($f, 4);
    if (fread($f, 4) !== 'ftyp') { fclose($f); return ['ok' => false, 'duur' => 0, 'fout' => 'Dit is geen mp4-video.']; }
    $moov = $zoek(0, $eind, 'moov');
    if (!$moov) { fclose($f); return ['ok' => false, 'duur' => 0, 'fout' => 'Deze video is niet compleet of beschadigd.']; }
    $duur = 0;
    $mvhd = $zoek($moov[0], $moov[1], 'mvhd');
    if ($mvhd) {
        fseek($f, $mvhd[0]); $d = fread($f, 36);
        if (strlen($d) >= 32) {
            if (ord($d[0]) === 1) { $ts = unpack('N', substr($d, 20, 4))[1]; $x = unpack('Nhoog/Nlaag', substr($d, 24, 8)); $du = $x['hoog'] * 4294967296 + $x['laag']; }
            else { $ts = unpack('N', substr($d, 12, 4))[1]; $du = unpack('N', substr($d, 16, 4))[1]; }
            if ($ts > 0 && $du > 0 && $du < 4294967295) $duur = $du / $ts;
        }
    }
    $lees = min(4 * 1024 * 1024, $moov[1] - $moov[0]);
    fseek($f, $moov[0]); $inh = (string)fread($f, $lees);
    fclose($f);
    if (strpos($inh, 'hvc1') !== false || strpos($inh, 'hev1') !== false) {
        return ['ok' => false, 'duur' => $duur, 'fout' => 'Deze video is opgeslagen als HEVC (zo filmt een iPhone standaard). Niet elke browser kan dat afspelen. Zet op je iPhone bij Instellingen, Camera, Formaten op Meest compatibel en film opnieuw, of kies de video op een computer met Chrome of Edge: dan maakt de beheerpagina hem zelf geschikt.'];
    }
    if (strpos($inh, 'avc1') === false && strpos($inh, 'avc3') === false) {
        return ['ok' => false, 'duur' => $duur, 'fout' => 'Deze video is in een vorm opgeslagen die niet elke browser kan afspelen. Kies een gewone mp4 van je telefoon.'];
    }
    return ['ok' => true, 'duur' => $duur, 'fout' => ''];
}
function beweging_snelheid() { global $SNELHEDEN; $s = st('beweging_snelheid'); return $SNELHEDEN[$s][1] ?? '1'; }

  function rgba(hex, a) { var n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16); return 'rgba(' + (n >> 16) + ',' + ((n >> 8) & 255) + ',' + (n & 255) + ',' + a + ')'; }

  function maak(el, type, snelheid) {

    var t0 = Math.random() * 100;

      var d = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, smal ? 1.25 : 1.5);
      cv.width = Math.round(w * d); cv.height = Math.round(h * d); ctx.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0); teken(performance.now() / 1000);
    }
    function gloed(x, y, r, kleur, a) {
      var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
      g.addColorStop(0, rgba(kleur, .8 * a)); g.addColorStop(.45, rgba(kleur, .4 * a)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(kleur, 0));
      ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2);
    }
    function rnd(i) { var x = Math.sin(i * 127.1 + 45.2) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x); }
    function lucht(a, b) { var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h); g.addColorStop(0, a); g.addColorStop(1, b); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); }
    function rondje(x, y, r, k) { ctx.fillStyle = k; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); }
    function golf(y, a, k, f) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, h); for (var x = 0; x <= w + 12; x += 12) ctx.lineTo(x, y + Math.sin(x * .012 + f) * a + Math.sin(x * .025 - f * .7) * a * .25); ctx.lineTo(w, h); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle = k; ctx.fill(); }
    /* Op een breed scherm staat het onderwerp rechts, naast de tekst. Op een telefoon in het midden, achter de tekst. */
    function mx(v) { return smal ? w * (.5 + (v - .7) * .6) : w * v; }
    var sc = Math.min(w / 900, 1.2);
    function boot(x, y, s) {
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.scale(s, s);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#13283c'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-110, 0); ctx.lineTo(120, 0); ctx.lineTo(78, 34); ctx.lineTo(-80, 34); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e6ecf2'; ctx.fillRect(-50, -50, 110, 50); ctx.fillStyle = '#d7e8ee'; ctx.fillRect(-20, -85, 48, 35);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#79b8dc'; for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) ctx.fillRect(-40 + i * 21, -38, 12, 14);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#e3efff'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(15, -85); ctx.lineTo(15, -132); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
    }
    function palm(x, y, s, t) {
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.scale(s, s);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#4e3025'; ctx.lineWidth = 12; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 0); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(15, -75, -12, -160); ctx.stroke();
      for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) { ctx.save(); ctx.translate(-12, -160); ctx.rotate(i * .7854 + Math.sin(t * .6) * .06); ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? '#245e43' : '#318354'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(37, 0, 48, 9, 0, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore(); }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    var SC = {
      zee: function (t) {
        lucht('#091e40', '#ffb17b'); rondje(mx(.8), h * .34, 42 * sc + 10, '#ffda9b');
        golf(h * .58, 13, '#1a7394', t * .65); golf(h * .68, 16, '#0d5379', t);
        boot(mx(.66) + Math.sin(t * .18) * w * (smal ? .05 : .1), h * .59 + Math.sin(t * 1.8) * 6, sc * (smal ? .8 : 1));
        golf(h * .79, 19, '#073b62', t * 1.2);
        for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(196,239,255,.4)'; ctx.fillRect(rnd(i) * w, h * .81 + Math.sin(t + i) * 12, rnd(i + 12) * 65 + 15, 2); }
      },
      eiland: function (t) {
        lucht('#4fa9c9', '#ffcf9e'); rondje(mx(.84), h * .22, 40 * sc + 10, '#ffeab0');
        golf(h * .67, 8, '#1f9fb0', t * .5);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#d9c38b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(mx(.7), h * .72, w * (smal ? .45 : .26), h * .12, 0, Math.PI, 0); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#38845a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(mx(.7), h * .67, w * (smal ? .34 : .2), h * .09, 0, Math.PI, 0); ctx.fill();
        palm(mx(.6), h * .69, sc, t); palm(mx(.82), h * .7, sc * .65, t + 1);
        golf(h * .85, 7, '#0c8ea9', t);
      },
      ruimte: function (t) {
        lucht('#04051a', '#20215c');
        for (var i = 0; i < (smal ? 90 : 160); i++) rondje(rnd(i) * w, rnd(i + 200) * h, rnd(i + 400) * 1.6 + .3, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (.35 + .6 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * .5 + i))).toFixed(2) + ')');
        var m = Math.min(w, h); rondje(mx(.78), h * .42, m * .19, '#5a5db8'); rondje(mx(.78) - m * .03, h * .42 - m * .04, m * .15, '#8c85d5');
        ctx.save(); ctx.translate(mx(.62) + Math.sin(t * .18) * w * .08, h * (.55 + Math.cos(t * .2) * .1)); ctx.rotate(-.2); ctx.scale(sc, sc);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#d7eaff'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(90, 0); ctx.lineTo(-50, -24); ctx.lineTo(-25, 0); ctx.lineTo(-50, 24); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#47d7ff'; ctx.fillRect(-66, -8, 30, 16); ctx.restore();
      },
      neonstad: function (t) {
        lucht('#100c2e', '#572d70');
        var n = smal ? 12 : 22;
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          var x = i * w / (n - 1), bh = h * .2 + rnd(i) * h * .45; ctx.fillStyle = '#241b43'; ctx.fillRect(x, h * .82 - bh, w / n + 2, bh);
          for (var j = 0; j < 8; j++) for (var k = 0; k < 3; k++) if (rnd(i * 100 + j * 5 + k) > .45) { ctx.fillStyle = (i + j + Math.floor(t * .4 + rnd(i + j))) % 5 === 0 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.15)' : ((i + j) % 2 ? '#fa4cc8' : '#36d9ff'); ctx.fillRect(x + 5 + k * 10, h * .84 - bh + j * 18, 5, 8); }
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#101029'; ctx.fillRect(0, h * .82, w, h * .18);
        for (var q = 0; q < 12; q++) { ctx.fillStyle = q % 2 ? '#4deaff' : '#ff61dc'; ctx.fillRect((rnd(q) * w + t * (40 + q * 6)) % (w + 40) - 40, h * .84 + rnd(q + 40) * h * .14, 30, 3); }
      },
      vulkaan: function (t) {
        lucht('#170a20', '#9c2e22'); rondje(mx(.86), h * .22, 34 * sc + 14, '#f97438');
        var c = mx(.7);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#201b29'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(c - w * .45, h); ctx.lineTo(c - w * .14, h * .5); ctx.lineTo(c - w * .05, h * .4); ctx.lineTo(c + w * .05, h * .4); ctx.lineTo(c + w * .45, h); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff6d22'; ctx.lineWidth = 10; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(c, h * .41); ctx.bezierCurveTo(c - w * .02, h * .65, c + w * .1, h * .7, c + w * .13, h); ctx.stroke();
        for (var i = 0; i < 45; i++) { var y = h * .4 - ((t * (15 + rnd(i) * 35) + rnd(i + 100) * h * .8) % (h * .45)); rondje(c + (rnd(i) - .5) * w * .16 + Math.sin(t + i) * 14, y, rnd(i + 400) * 3 + 1, '#ff9c43'); }
      }
    };
    function teken(s) {
      var t = (s + t0) * sp;
      if (th.scene) {
        sc = Math.min(w / 900, 1.2); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; SC[type](t);
        /* Donkere laag aan de kant van de tekst, zodat witte tekst altijd leesbaar is */
        var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, 0);
        if (smal) { g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(5,10,25,.62)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(5,10,25,.62)'); }
        else { g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(5,10,25,.72)'); g.addColorStop(.5, 'rgba(5,10,25,.45)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(5,10,25,.08)'); }
        ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
        return;
      }
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; ctx.fillStyle = th.bg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
      if (GLOED.indexOf(type) >= 0) {
        var n = type === 'lava' ? 5 : type === 'spotlight' ? 2 : 7;
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          var f = i * 2.399, x = w * (.5 + .35 * Math.sin(t * (.12 + i * .012) + f)), y = h * (.5 + .3 * Math.cos(t * (.17 + i * .01) + f));
          if (type === 'lava') { x = w * (.5 + .13 * Math.sin(t * .35 + f)); y = h * (.5 + .15 * Math.cos(t * .42 + f)); }
          if (type === 'noorderlicht') { x = w * (i / (n - 1)); y = h * (.38 + .22 * Math.sin(t * .24 + i * .8)); }
          if (type === 'spotlight') { x = w * (.35 + .3 * Math.sin(t * .3 + i * 2)); y = h * .15; }
          var r = Math.max(w, h) * (type === 'lava' ? .25 : type === 'noorderlicht' ? .46 : .34) * .75;
          gloed(x, y, r, th.c[i % 3], type === 'chroom' ? .65 : 1);
        }
      }
      if (STIP.indexOf(type) >= 0) {
        for (var j = 0; j < stippen.length; j++) {
          var p = stippen[j], px = p.x * w + Math.sin(t * .3 + p.p) * 14, py = (((p.y - t * p.v * (type === 'vuur' ? .055 : .014)) % 1) + 1) % 1 * h, pr = p.r * (type === 'bellen' ? 4 : 1.2) * .75;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, pr, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fillStyle = rgba(th.c[j % 3], .35 + .4 * Math.pow(Math.sin(t + p.p), 2)); ctx.fill();
          if (type === 'bellen') { ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.3)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); }
        }
      }
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      var dk = DONKER[type] || .22;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,' + dk + ')'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      var sh = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h); sh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,.05)'); sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)'); ctx.fillStyle = sh; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    }
    function tik(ms) {
      if (weg) return;
      if (zicht && !stil.matches && !document.hidden && (!stap || ms - laatst >= stap)) { laatst = ms; teken(ms / 1000); }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tik);
    }
    var ro = window.ResizeObserver ? new ResizeObserver(maat) : null; if (ro) ro.observe(el); else window.addEventListener('resize', maat);
    var io = window.IntersectionObserver ? new IntersectionObserver(function (e) { zicht = e[0] ? e[0].isIntersecting : true; }) : null; if (io) io.observe(el);
    maat(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(tik);
    return {
      type: type,
      snelheid: function (v) { sp = Math.max(.2, Math.min(3, +v || 1)); },
      stop: function () { weg = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); if (ro) ro.disconnect(); else window.removeEventListener('resize', maat); if (io) io.disconnect(); cv.remove(); el.classList.remove('ffm-host'); el.style.backgroundColor = oudeKleur; }
    };
  }

  /* Zet een effect op een element, of haal het weg met type '' */
  function zet(el, type, snelheid) {
    if (!el) return;
    if (el._ffm && el._ffm.type === type) { el._ffm.snelheid(snelheid); return; }
    if (el._ffm) { el._ffm.stop(); el._ffm = null; }
    if (type && E[type]) el._ffm = E[type].d3 ? maak3d(el, type, snelheid) : maak(el, type, snelheid);
  }
  function start() {
    var l = document.querySelectorAll('[data-ffm]');
    for (var i = 0; i < l.length; i++) zet(l[i], l[i].getAttribute('data-ffm'), l[i].getAttribute('data-ffm-s'));
  }
  window.FFM = { effecten: E, zet: zet, start: start };
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start); else start();
})();
FFMJS;
}
function opbouw($deel) {
    global $OPBOUW;
    $v = st('opbouw_' . $deel);
    return isset($OPBOUW[$deel][$v]) ? $v : 'standaard';
}

         . ' l-menu-' . opbouw('menu') . ' l-strook-' . opbouw('strook') . ' l-afsl-' . opbouw('afsluiter') . ' l-voet-' . opbouw('voet');
}

/* Grote foto bovenaan: bij de stijl Etalage, of als de klant dat kiest */
function banner_achter() { return st('banner') !== '' && st('banner_vorm') !== 'strook'; }
function banner_strook() { return st('banner') !== '' && st('banner_vorm') === 'strook'; }
/* Extra bannerfoto's (max 4) die met de eerste in een lus wisselen */
function banner_dia() {
    global $ST; $uit = [];
    foreach ((array)($ST['banner_dia'] ?? []) as $f) { if (is_string($f) && $f !== '' && is_file(UPLOAD_DIR . '/site/' . basename($f))) $uit[] = basename($f); }
    return array_slice($uit, 0, 4);
}
/* Wisselende foto's: rustig in- en uitfaden met een lichte zoom, 6 seconden per foto, zonder JavaScript */
function dia_html() {
    $extra = banner_dia();
    if (!$extra || st('banner') === '') return '';
    $fotos = array_merge([basename(st('banner'))], $extra);
    $n = count($fotos); $T = 6 * $n;
    $p1 = round(1.5 / $T * 100, 2); $p2 = round(6 / $T * 100, 2); $p3 = round(7.5 / $T * 100, 2);
    $o = '<style>@keyframes dia' . $n . '{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1)}' . $p1 . '%{opacity:1}' . $p2 . '%{opacity:1}' . $p3 . '%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.07)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.07)}}'
        . '.hero-dia span{animation:dia' . $n . ' ' . $T . 's linear infinite}</style><div class="hero-dia" aria-hidden="true">';
    foreach ($fotos as $i => $f) { $o .= '<span style="background-image:url(\'/uploads/site/' . h(rawurlencode($f)) . '\');animation-delay:' . ($i * 6) . 's"></span>'; }
    return $o . '</div>';
}
function hero_met_foto() {
    return banner_achter() || stijl_grote_foto() || opbouw('hero') === 'foto';
}
/* Zet de gekozen stijl in een gemaakte pagina */
function stijl_pagina($html) {
    $s = stijl();
    $css = stijl_css($s);
    $kiezer = file_exists(DATA_DIR . '/demo-aan.txt');
    if ($kiezer) {
        // Voorbeeldsite: de stijl staat in een eigen blok, zodat de stijlkiezer hem kan wisselen
        $alle = alle_stijlen();
        $f = $alle[$s]['fonts'] ?? '';
        $css = '<link id="ff-fonts" rel="stylesheet" href="' . ($f !== '' ? 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?' . h($f) . '&display=swap' : 'data:text/css,') . '" />' . "\n"
             . '<style id="ff-stijl">' . "\n" . ($alle[$s]['css'] ?? '') . "\n</style>\n";
    }
    $css .= maatwerk_css();
    $pos = strpos($html, '</head>');
    if ($pos !== false) { $html = substr($html, 0, $pos) . $css . substr($html, $pos); }
    $pos = strpos($html, '<body>');
    if ($pos !== false) { $html = substr($html, 0, $pos) . '<body class="' . body_klassen($s) . '">' . ($kiezer ? stijl_kiezer($s) : '') . substr($html, $pos + 6); }
    /* Bewegende achtergrond: alleen op een pagina met de bovenkant, en alleen als hij aan staat of de stijlkiezer erop staat */
    if (strpos($html, '<section class="hero') !== false && (beweging() !== '' || $kiezer)) {
        $e = strrpos($html, '</body>');
        if ($e !== false) { $html = substr($html, 0, $e) . '<script>' . ffm_js() . '</script>' . "\n" . substr($html, $e); }
    }
    return $html;
}

    document.getElementById('ff-stijl').textContent = s.css;
    document.getElementById('ff-fonts').href = s.fonts ? 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?' + s.fonts + '&display=swap' : 'data:text/css,';
    document.body.className = (document.body.className.replace(/(^|\s)t-[a-z0-9-]+/g, ' ') + ' t-' + k).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    kies.value = k;
    fotoBijwerken();
    if (bewaar) { try { localStorage.setItem(sleutel, k); } catch (e) {} }
  }
  function stap(n) {
    var i = (lijst.indexOf(kies.value) + n + lijst.length) % lijst.length;
    zet(lijst[i], true);
    zetO(1 + (i % (OPB.length - 1)), true);
  }
  lijst.forEach(function(k){
    var o = document.createElement('option');
    o.value = k; o.textContent = 'Stijl: ' + D.stijlen[k].naam;
    kies.appendChild(o);
  });
  OPB.forEach(function(o, i){
    var e = document.createElement('option');
    e.value = String(i); e.textContent = 'Indeling: ' + o[0] + (i > 0 && o[1][1] === 'foto' ? ', met grote foto bovenaan' : '');
    kiesO.appendChild(e);
  });
  kies.onchange = function(){ zet(kies.value, true); };
  kiesO.onchange = function(){ zetO(parseInt(kiesO.value, 10) || 0, true); };
  document.querySelector('.ffk .ffk-v').onclick = function(){ stap(-1); };
  document.querySelector('.ffk .ffk-n').onclick = function(){ stap(1); };
  var start = (gekozen && D.stijlen[gekozen]) ? gekozen : D.standaard;
  var startO = parseInt(gekozenO, 10); if (!(startO >= 0 && startO < OPB.length)) startO = 0;
  function begin() { zet(start, false); zetO(startO, null); }
  begin();
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', begin); }
})();
</script>
HTML;
}
/* Eerste projectfoto, voor de grote foto in de stijl Etalage */
function hero_foto($pages) {
    if (banner_achter()) { return '/uploads/site/' . rawurlencode(st('banner')); }
    list($featured, $projects) = site_lists($pages);
    foreach (array_merge($featured, $projects) as $p) { if (!empty($p['photo'])) return $p['photo']; }
    return '';
}
function paragraphs($text) {
    $out = [];
    foreach (preg_split('/\R{2,}/', trim((string)$text)) as $p) { if (trim($p) !== '') $out[] = trim($p); }
    return $out;
}
function home_title() {
    if (st('seo_titel') !== '') return st('seo_titel');
    $t = st('naam');
    if (st('eyebrow') !== '') $t .= ' | ' . st('eyebrow');
    return $t;
}
function home_desc() {
    if (st('seo_omschrijving') !== '') return cut(st('seo_omschrijving'), 160);
    $names = array_values(cat_names());
    $d = st('naam') . (st('plaats') !== '' ? ' uit ' . st('plaats') : '') . '. ' . st('hero_tekst');
    if (!empty($names)) $d .= ' Diensten: ' . implode(', ', $names) . '.';
    return cut($d, 160);
}

/* ===========================================================
   Versies: "Terug naar gisteren"
   Bij elke keer opslaan van Instellingen of Projecten bewaren we hoe de
   website daarna is (data/versies/). De klant kan elke versie met 1 knop
   terugzetten. Foto's die worden vervangen of verwijderd gaan eerst naar
   een prullenbak (data/versies/foto/), zodat een oude versie ze terugkrijgt.
   =========================================================== */
define('VERSIE_DIR', DATA_DIR . '/versies');
define('VERSIE_MAX', 60);
function versie_staat() {
    $st = file_exists(SETTINGS_FILE) ? json_decode((string)file_get_contents(SETTINGS_FILE), true) : null;
    $pg = file_exists(PAGES_FILE) ? json_decode((string)file_get_contents(PAGES_FILE), true) : null;
    return ['settings' => is_array($st) ? $st : [], 'pages' => is_array($pg) ? $pg : []];
}
function versie_bestanden() {
    $l = is_dir(VERSIE_DIR) ? (glob(VERSIE_DIR . '/v-*.json') ?: []) : [];
    rsort($l);
    return $l;
}
function versie_lijst() {
    $uit = [];
    foreach (versie_bestanden() as $f) {
        $d = json_decode((string)@file_get_contents($f), true);
        if (is_array($d) && !empty($d['id'])) { $uit[] = ['id' => $d['id'], 'op' => $d['op'] ?? '', 'wat' => $d['wat'] ?? '']; }
    }
    return $uit;
}
function versie_schrijf($wat, $staat) {
    if (!is_dir(VERSIE_DIR)) { @mkdir(VERSIE_DIR, 0755, true); }
    $mt = microtime(true); $id = date('YmdHis', (int)$mt) . sprintf('%06d', (int)(($mt - floor($mt)) * 1000000)) . '-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3));
    @file_put_contents(VERSIE_DIR . '/v-' . $id . '.json', json_encode(['id' => $id, 'op' => date('c'), 'wat' => $wat, 'settings' => $staat['settings'], 'pages' => $staat['pages']], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES), LOCK_EX);
    foreach (array_slice(versie_bestanden(), VERSIE_MAX) as $oud) { @unlink($oud); }
    // Foto's in de prullenbak die ouder zijn dan 120 dagen mogen weg
    foreach ((glob(VERSIE_DIR . '/foto/*') ?: []) as $f) { if (is_file($f) && filemtime($f) < time() - 120 * 86400) { @unlink($f); } }
    return $id;
}
/* Wordt aangeroepen vlak voordat settings.json of pages.json wordt overschreven */
function versie_voor($soort, $nieuw) {
    if (!empty($GLOBALS['is_demo']) || !empty($GLOBALS['ff_versie_stil'])) return;
    $oud = versie_staat();
    // Nog geen enkele versie? Bewaar dan eerst hoe het was, zodat je daar altijd naar terug kunt
    if (!versie_bestanden() && ($oud['settings'] || $oud['pages'])) { versie_schrijf('Zoals de website was', $oud); }
    $GLOBALS['ff_versie_wat'][] = $soort === 'settings' ? versie_wat_settings($oud['settings'], $nieuw) : versie_wat_pages($oud['pages'], $nieuw);
    if (empty($GLOBALS['ff_versie_klaar'])) {
        $GLOBALS['ff_versie_klaar'] = 1;
        register_shutdown_function(function () {
            $w = array_values(array_unique(array_filter($GLOBALS['ff_versie_wat'] ?? [])));
            if ($w) { versie_schrijf(implode('. ', $w), versie_staat()); }
        });
    }
}
function versie_wat_settings($oud, $nieuw) {
    $groepen = ['Bedrijf' => '/^(naam|straat|postcode|plaats|provincie|tel2?|whatsapp.*|email|kvk|tijden|werkgebied)$/', 'Voorpagina' => '/^(slogan|banner.*|eyebrow|hero_.*|knop_.*|cta_.*|menulinks)$/',
        'Diensten' => '/^diensten.*$/', 'Uiterlijk' => '/^(logo|stijl|kleur_.*|lettertype|vorm|feest_kleuren|beweging.*)$/', 'Opbouw' => '/^opbouw_.*$/',
        'Blokken' => '/^(blokken|voorna.*|werkwijze.*|cijfers.*|over_.*|vragen.*|beelden|woord_.*)$/', 'Extra' => '/^(seo_.*|site_url|chat_url)$/'];
    $wat = [];
    foreach (array_unique(array_merge(array_keys($oud), array_keys($nieuw))) as $k) {
        if (json_encode($oud[$k] ?? null) === json_encode($nieuw[$k] ?? null)) continue;
        $g = 'Overig'; foreach ($groepen as $naam => $re) { if (preg_match($re, $k)) { $g = $naam; break; } }
        $wat[$g] = 1;
    }
    return $wat ? 'Instellingen: ' . implode(', ', array_keys($wat)) : '';
}
function versie_wat_pages($oud, $nieuw) {
    $o = []; foreach ($oud as $p) { $o[$p['slug'] ?? ''] = $p; }
    $n = []; foreach ($nieuw as $p) { $n[$p['slug'] ?? ''] = $p; }
    $wat = [];
    foreach ($n as $sl => $p) { if (!isset($o[$sl])) { $wat[] = 'project "' . page_title($p) . '" toegevoegd'; } elseif (json_encode($o[$sl]) !== json_encode($p)) { $wat[] = 'project "' . page_title($p) . '" aangepast'; } }
    foreach ($o as $sl => $p) { if (!isset($n[$sl])) { $wat[] = 'project "' . page_title($p) . '" verwijderd'; } }
    return $wat ? ucfirst(implode(', ', array_slice($wat, 0, 3))) . (count($wat) > 3 ? ' en meer' : '') : '';
}
/* Foto's niet meteen weggooien, maar in de prullenbak zetten ($rel is het pad binnen uploads/) */
function foto_weg($rel) {
    $rel = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', (string)$rel), '/');
    if ($rel === '' || strpos($rel, '..') !== false) return;
    $bron = UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $rel;
    if (!is_file($bron)) return;
    if (!empty($GLOBALS['is_demo'])) return;
    $map = VERSIE_DIR . '/foto';
    if (!is_dir($map)) { @mkdir($map, 0755, true); }
    $doel = $map . '/' . str_replace('/', '__', $rel);
    if (!@rename($bron, $doel)) { @unlink($bron); } else { @touch($doel); }
}
function foto_map_weg($rel) {
    $rel = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', (string)$rel), '/');
    if ($rel === '' || strpos($rel, '..') !== false || !is_dir(UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $rel)) return;
    foreach (scandir(UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $rel) as $f) { if ($f !== '.' && $f !== '..' && is_file(UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $rel . '/' . $f)) { foto_weg($rel . '/' . $f); } }
    rrmdir(UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $rel);
}
/* Alle foto's die een versie gebruikt (pad binnen uploads/) */
function versie_fotos($staat) {
    $s = $staat['settings']; $uit = [];
    foreach (['banner', 'logo', 'over_foto', 'video', 'video_beeld'] as $k) { if (!empty($s[$k]) && is_string($s[$k])) $uit[] = 'site/' . basename($s[$k]); }
    foreach ((array)($s['banner_dia'] ?? []) as $f) { if (is_string($f) && $f !== '') $uit[] = 'site/' . basename($f); }
    foreach ((array)($s['beelden'] ?? []) as $b) { if (!empty($b['foto'])) $uit[] = 'site/' . basename($b['foto']); }
    foreach ((array)($s['voorna'] ?? []) as $v) { foreach (['voor', 'na'] as $kk) { if (!empty($v[$kk])) $uit[] = 'site/' . basename($v[$kk]); } }
    foreach ($staat['pages'] as $p) { foreach ((array)($p['photos'] ?? []) as $f) { $uit[] = ($p['slug'] ?? '') . '/' . basename((string)$f); } }
    return array_values(array_unique($uit));
}
function versie_terugzetten($id) {
    if (!preg_match('/^[0-9]{14}([0-9]{6})?-[0-9a-f]{6}$/', (string)$id)) return 'Deze versie bestaat niet.';
    $d = json_decode((string)@file_get_contents(VERSIE_DIR . '/v-' . $id . '.json'), true);
    if (!is_array($d) || !isset($d['settings'], $d['pages'])) return 'Deze versie kon niet worden gelezen.';
    $nu = versie_staat();
    // Foto's die nodig zijn terughalen uit de prullenbak
    $mist = 0;
    foreach (versie_fotos($d) as $rel) {
        if (is_file(UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $rel)) continue;
        $pb = VERSIE_DIR . '/foto/' . str_replace('/', '__', $rel);
        if (is_file($pb)) { if (!is_dir(dirname(UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $rel))) { @mkdir(dirname(UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $rel), 0755, true); } @copy($pb, UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $rel); }
        else { $mist++; }
    }
    // Projectpagina's die in de oude versie niet bestonden, weghalen van de website
    $oudeSlugs = array_map(function($p) { return $p['slug'] ?? ''; }, $d['pages']);
    foreach ($nu['pages'] as $p) { $sl = $p['slug'] ?? ''; if ($sl !== '' && preg_match('/^[a-z0-9-]+$/', $sl) && !in_array($sl, $oudeSlugs, true)) { rrmdir(ROOT . '/' . $sl); } }
    $GLOBALS['ff_versie_stil'] = 1;
    write_json(PAGES_FILE, array_values($d['pages']));
    file_put_contents(SETTINGS_FILE, json_encode($d['settings'], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES), LOCK_EX);
    $GLOBALS['ST'] = load_settings();
    rebuild_everything(load_pages());
    versie_schrijf('Teruggezet naar de versie van ' . nl_datum(substr($d['op'], 0, 10)) . ' ' . substr($d['op'], 11, 5), versie_staat());
    return $mist ? 'Teruggezet. ' . $mist . ($mist === 1 ? " foto was" : " foto's waren") . ' niet meer te vinden en ' . ($mist === 1 ? 'staat' : 'staan') . ' er niet bij.' : '';
}

/* ===========================================================

function ensure_data_dir() {
    if (!is_dir(DATA_DIR)) { mkdir(DATA_DIR, 0755, true); }
    if (!file_exists(DATA_DIR . '/.htaccess')) { file_put_contents(DATA_DIR . '/.htaccess', "Require all denied\n"); }
}
function ensure_upload_dir() {
    if (!is_dir(UPLOAD_DIR)) { mkdir(UPLOAD_DIR, 0755, true); }
    if (!file_exists(UPLOAD_DIR . '/.htaccess')) {
        file_put_contents(UPLOAD_DIR . '/.htaccess', "<FilesMatch \"\\.(php|php\\d|phtml|phar|pl|py|cgi|sh|htaccess)$\">\nRequire all denied\n</FilesMatch>\nOptions -Indexes\n");
    }
}
function read_json($f, $default) {
    if (!file_exists($f)) return $default;
    $d = json_decode(file_get_contents($f), true);
    return is_array($d) ? $d : $default;
}
function write_json($f, $data) {
    ensure_data_dir();
    file_put_contents($f, json_encode($data, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES), LOCK_EX);
}
function load_config() { return read_json(CONFIG_FILE, null); }
function save_config($c) { write_json(CONFIG_FILE, $c); }
function load_pages() { return read_json(PAGES_FILE, []); }
function save_pages($pages) { versie_voor('pages', array_values($pages)); write_json(PAGES_FILE, array_values($pages)); }
function load_aanvragen() { return read_json(DATA_DIR . '/aanvragen.json', []); }

/* ===========================================================
   Hulpfuncties
   =========================================================== */
function h($s) { return htmlspecialchars((string)$s, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8'); }
function cut($s, $n) { return function_exists('mb_substr') ? mb_substr($s, 0, $n) : substr($s, 0, $n); }

function slugify($text) {
    $text = trim($text);
    $from = ["\u{e1}","\u{e0}","\u{e4}","\u{e2}","\u{e9}","\u{e8}","\u{eb}","\u{ea}","\u{ed}","\u{ec}","\u{ef}","\u{ee}","\u{f3}","\u{f2}","\u{f6}","\u{f4}","\u{fa}","\u{f9}","\u{fc}","\u{fb}","\u{f1}","\u{e7}",
             "\u{c1}","\u{c0}","\u{c4}","\u{c2}","\u{c9}","\u{c8}","\u{cb}","\u{ca}","\u{cd}","\u{cc}","\u{cf}","\u{ce}","\u{d3}","\u{d2}","\u{d6}","\u{d4}","\u{da}","\u{d9}","\u{dc}","\u{db}","\u{d1}","\u{c7}"];
    $to   = ['a','a','a','a','e','e','e','e','i','i','i','i','o','o','o','o','u','u','u','u','n','c',
             'a','a','a','a','e','e','e','e','i','i','i','i','o','o','o','o','u','u','u','u','n','c'];
    $text = str_replace($from, $to, $text);
    $text = strtolower($text);
    $text = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '-', $text);
    $text = trim($text, '-');
    return $text === '' ? 'pagina' : $text;
}
/* Mappen van de site die de admin zelf maakt (dienstpagina's) */
function generated_slugs() { return read_json(GENERATED_FILE, []); }
function service_slugs() { return array_values(array_map(function($d) { return $d['slug']; }, services())); }

function unique_slug($base, $pages, $ignore = null) {
    global $RESERVED;
    $svc = service_slugs();
    $slug = $base; $i = 2;
    $taken = function($s) use ($pages, $ignore, $RESERVED, $svc) {
        if (in_array($s, $RESERVED, true) || in_array($s, $svc, true)) return true;
        foreach ($pages as $p) { if ($p['slug'] === $s && $p['slug'] !== $ignore) return true; }
        if ($s !== $ignore && file_exists(ROOT . '/' . $s)) return true;
        return false;
    };
    while ($taken($slug)) { $slug = $base . '-' . $i; $i++; }
    return $slug;
}
function rrmdir($dir) {
    if (!is_dir($dir)) return;
    foreach (scandir($dir) as $item) {
        if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') continue;
        $path = $dir . '/' . $item;
        is_dir($path) ? rrmdir($path) : @unlink($path);
    }
    @rmdir($dir);
}
function page_folder($p) {
    $f = $p['folder'] ?? '';
    return in_array($f, ['featured', 'projects'], true) ? $f : '';
}
function page_cats($p) {
    $names = cat_names();
    $out = [];
    foreach (($p['cats'] ?? []) as $c) { if (isset($names[$c]) && !in_array($c, $out, true)) { $out[] = $c; } }
    return $out;
}
function clean_cats($in) { return page_cats(['cats' => is_array($in) ? $in : []]); }
function photo_url($slug, $file) { return '/uploads/' . rawurlencode($slug) . '/' . rawurlencode($file); }
function page_title($p) { return trim($p['display_title'] ?? '') !== '' ? $p['display_title'] : $p['title']; }

/* Grote telefoonfoto's verkleinen en rechtop zetten (alleen jpg, alleen als de server dat kan) */
function shrink_photo($path) {
    $max = 2000;
    if (!function_exists('imagecreatefromjpeg') || !function_exists('exif_read_data')) return;
    $info = @getimagesize($path);
    if (!$info || $info[2] !== IMAGETYPE_JPEG) return;
    $w = $info[0]; $hgt = $info[1];
    $exif = @exif_read_data($path);
    $orient = is_array($exif) && isset($exif['Orientation']) ? (int)$exif['Orientation'] : 1;
    if (max($w, $hgt) <= $max && $orient === 1) return;
    $src = @imagecreatefromjpeg($path);
    if (!$src) return;
    if ($orient === 3) { $src = imagerotate($src, 180, 0); }
    elseif ($orient === 6) { $src = imagerotate($src, -90, 0); }
    elseif ($orient === 8) { $src = imagerotate($src, 90, 0); }
    $w = imagesx($src); $hgt = imagesy($src);
    $scale = min(1, $max / max($w, $hgt));
    $nw = (int)round($w * $scale); $nh = (int)round($hgt * $scale);
    $dst = imagecreatetruecolor($nw, $nh);
    imagecopyresampled($dst, $src, 0, 0, 0, 0, $nw, $nh, $w, $hgt);
    @imagejpeg($dst, $path, 84);
    imagedestroy($src); imagedestroy($dst);
}

/* Een geuploade afbeelding controleren en opslaan. Geeft bestandsnaam of '' terug. */
function save_one_image($tmp, $name, $dir, $prefix, &$errors) {
    $types = [IMAGETYPE_JPEG => 'jpg', IMAGETYPE_PNG => 'png', IMAGETYPE_WEBP => 'webp', IMAGETYPE_GIF => 'gif'];
    if (!is_uploaded_file($tmp)) return '';
    if (filesize($tmp) > MAX_PHOTO_BYTES) { $errors[] = "'" . $name . "' is groter dan 8 MB."; return ''; }
    $info = @getimagesize($tmp);
    if (!$info || !isset($types[$info[2]])) { $errors[] = "'" . $name . "' is geen jpg, png, webp of gif."; return ''; }
    if (!is_dir($dir)) { mkdir($dir, 0755, true); }
    $file = $prefix . date('Ymd-His') . '-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4)) . '.' . $types[$info[2]];
    if (move_uploaded_file($tmp, $dir . '/' . $file)) { shrink_photo($dir . '/' . $file); return $file; }
    return '';
}
function upload_error_text($err, $name) {
    if ($err === UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE || $err === UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE) return "'" . $name . "' is te groot voor de server.";
    return "'" . $name . "' kon niet worden geupload (foutcode " . $err . ").";
}
function save_uploaded_photos($slug, &$errors) {
    $saved = [];
    if (empty($_FILES['photos']) || !is_array($_FILES['photos']['name'])) return $saved;
    ensure_upload_dir();
    $count = count($_FILES['photos']['name']);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
        $err = $_FILES['photos']['error'][$i];
        if ($err === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) continue;
        if ($err !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) { $errors[] = upload_error_text($err, $_FILES['photos']['name'][$i]); continue; }
        $f = save_one_image($_FILES['photos']['tmp_name'][$i], $_FILES['photos']['name'][$i], UPLOAD_DIR . '/' . $slug, '', $errors);
        if ($f !== '') $saved[] = $f;
    }
    return $saved;
}

/* ===========================================================
   SEO-onderdelen
   =========================================================== */
function business_jsonld() {
    $data = [
        '@context' => 'https://schema.org',
        '@type'    => 'LocalBusiness',
        '@id'      => site_url() . '/#bedrijf',
        'name'     => st('naam'),
        'url'      => site_url() . '/',
    ];
    if (logo_url() !== '') { $data['logo'] = site_url() . logo_url(); $data['image'] = site_url() . logo_url(); }
    if (st('tel') !== '') $data['telephone'] = tel_link(st('tel'));
    if (st('email') !== '') $data['email'] = st('email');
    if (st('straat') !== '' || st('plaats') !== '') {
        $data['address'] = array_filter([
            '@type'           => 'PostalAddress',
            'streetAddress'   => st('straat'),
            'postalCode'      => st('postcode'),
            'addressLocality' => st('plaats'),
            'addressRegion'   => st('provincie'),
            'addressCountry'  => 'NL',
        ], function($v) { return $v !== ''; });
    }
    if (st('werkgebied') !== '') $data['areaServed'] = st('werkgebied');
    $names = array_values(cat_names());
    if (!empty($names)) $data['knowsAbout'] = $names;
    return '<script type="application/ld+json">' . json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_HEX_TAG) . '</script>';
}

function meta_desc_for($p) {
    $d = trim($p['desc'] ?? '');
    if ($d === '') { $d = trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $p['text'] ?? '')); }
    $names = cat_names();
    $cats = array_map(function($c) use ($names) { return $names[$c]; }, page_cats($p));
    $base = page_title($p) . (empty($cats) ? '' : ' (' . implode(', ', $cats) . ')') . '. Een project van ' . st('naam') . (st('plaats') !== '' ? ' uit ' . st('plaats') : '') . '.';
    $d = $d === '' ? $base : $d . ' - ' . $base;
    return cut($d, 155);
}

/* ===========================================================
   Vaste delen van elke pagina
   =========================================================== */
function theme_css() {
    $d = valid_color(st('kleur_donker'), '#0b1f3a');
    $a = valid_color(st('kleur_accent'), '#1d4ed8');
    return ":root{--navy:{$d};--navy-2:{$d};--blue:{$a};--stripe:{$a};--sky:#eef2f8;--line:#d7e0ee;--muted:#51607a;}\n"
         . "@supports (color: color-mix(in srgb, red 50%, blue)){:root{--navy-2:color-mix(in srgb,{$d} 86%,#fff);--stripe:color-mix(in srgb,{$a} 55%,#fff);--sky:color-mix(in srgb,{$a} 7%,#fff);--line:color-mix(in srgb,{$a} 14%,#e2e7ef);}}\n";
}

function site_head($title, $desc = '', $path = '', $extra = '', $fullTitle = false, $image = '') {

    $url = site_url();

    if ($desc !== '') { $seo .= '<meta name="description" content="' . h($desc) . '" />' . "\n"; }
    if ($path !== '') { $seo .= '<link rel="canonical" href="' . h($url . $path) . '" />' . "\n"; }
    $seo .= '<meta property="og:type" content="website" />' . "\n";
    $seo .= '<meta property="og:site_name" content="' . h(st('naam')) . '" />' . "\n";
    $seo .= '<meta property="og:locale" content="nl_NL" />' . "\n";
    $seo .= '<meta property="og:title" content="' . $t . '" />' . "\n";
    if ($desc !== '') { $seo .= '<meta property="og:description" content="' . h($desc) . '" />' . "\n"; }
    if ($path !== '') { $seo .= '<meta property="og:url" content="' . h($url . $path) . '" />' . "\n"; }
    $img = $image !== '' ? $image : logo_url();
    if ($img !== '') { $seo .= '<meta property="og:image" content="' . h($url . $img) . '" />' . "\n"; }

    $icon = logo_url() !== '' ? '<link rel="icon" href="' . h(logo_url()) . '" />' . "\n" . '<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="' . h(logo_url()) . '" />' : '';

{$icon}

function brand_html() {
    $logo = logo_url();
    $img = $logo !== '' ? '<img src="' . h($logo) . '" alt="" />' : '';
    return '<a class="brand" href="/" aria-label="' . h(st('naam')) . ', naar de voorpagina">' . $img . '<span class="name">' . h(st('naam')) . '</span></a>';
}
function slogan_bar() {
    return st('slogan') !== '' ? '<div class="notice"><div class="wrap">' . h(st('slogan')) . '</div></div>' . "\n" : '';
}
/* $backUrl leeg = menu van de voorpagina */
/* Hoe heet het werk op de site: projecten, boeken, fragmenten... (enkelvoud, meervoud) */
function werk_woord() {
    $e = trim((string)st('woord_project')); $m = trim((string)st('woord_projecten'));
    return [$e !== '' ? mb_strtolower(cut($e, 30), 'UTF-8') : 'project', $m !== '' ? mb_strtolower(cut($m, 30), 'UTF-8') : 'projecten'];
}
function werk_hoofd($w) { return mb_strtoupper(mb_substr($w, 0, 1, 'UTF-8'), 'UTF-8') . mb_substr($w, 1, null, 'UTF-8'); }
function site_header($backUrl = '', $backLabel = '') {
    $out = slogan_bar() . '<header class="top"><div class="wrap">' . brand_html() . '<nav class="menu" aria-label="Menu">';
    if ($backUrl === '') {
        if (!empty(services())) { $out .= '<a class="nav" href="/#diensten">Diensten</a>'; }
        $out .= (load_pages() ? '<a class="nav" href="/#projecten">' . h(werk_hoofd(werk_woord()[1])) . '</a>' : '') . ab_menu_link() . mk_menu_link();
        foreach (menu_links() as $ml) { $out .= '<a class="nav ml" href="' . h($ml['link']) . '">' . h($ml['tekst']) . '</a>'; }
    } else {
        $out .= '<a class="back" href="' . h($backUrl) . '" onclick="try{var r=document.referrer;if(r&&r.indexOf(location.origin+\'/\')===0&&history.length>1){history.back();return false;}}catch(e){}return true;"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 12H5M11 18l-6-6 6-6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg><span class="long">' . h($backLabel) . '</span><span class="short">Terug</span></a>';
    }
    $ri = res_inst();
    if (!empty($ri['aan']) && !empty($ri['knop'])) { $out .= '<a class="nav" href="/contact/">Contact</a><a class="cta" href="/reserveren/">' . h($ri['knoptekst']) . '</a></nav></div></header>' . "\n"; }
    else { $out .= (!empty($ri['aan']) ? '<a class="nav" href="/reserveren/">' . h($ri['knoptekst']) . '</a>' : '') . '<a class="cta" href="/contact/">Contact</a></nav></div></header>' . "\n"; }
    return $out;
}
function nap_block() {
    $cols = [];
    $adres = array_filter([st('straat'), trim(st('postcode') . ' ' . st('plaats'))]);
    $c = '<strong>' . h(st('naam')) . '</strong>';
    foreach ($adres as $r) { $c .= '<br />' . h($r); }
    if (st('kvk') !== '') { $c .= '<br />KvK ' . h(st('kvk')); }
    $cols[] = $c;
    $contact = [];
    if (st('tel') !== '') $contact[] = '<a href="tel:' . h(tel_link(st('tel'))) . '">' . h(st('tel')) . '</a>';
    if (st('tel2') !== '') $contact[] = '<a href="tel:' . h(tel_link(st('tel2'))) . '">' . h(st('tel2')) . '</a>';
    if (st('email') !== '') $contact[] = '<a href="mailto:' . h(st('email')) . '">' . h(st('email')) . '</a>';
    if (whatsapp_url() !== '') $contact[] = '<a href="' . h(whatsapp_url()) . '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">WhatsApp</a>';
    $contact[] = '<a href="/contact/">Contactformulier</a>';
    $cols[] = '<strong>Contact</strong><br />' . implode('<br />', $contact);
    $extra = '';
    if (st('tijden') !== '') $extra .= '<strong>Openingstijden</strong><br />' . nl2br(h(st('tijden')));
    if (st('werkgebied') !== '') $extra .= ($extra !== '' ? '<br />' : '') . '<strong>Werkgebied</strong><br />' . h(st('werkgebied'));
    if ($extra !== '') $cols[] = $extra;
    $links = [];
    foreach (services() as $k => $s) { $links[] = '<a href="' . h(service_url($k)) . '">' . h($s['naam']) . '</a>'; }
    if (!empty($links)) $cols[] = '<strong>Diensten</strong><br />' . implode('<br />', $links);
    $out = '<div class="nap">';
    foreach ($cols as $c) { $out .= '<div>' . $c . '</div>'; }
    return $out . '</div>';
}
function chat_fab() {
    $c = chat_url();
    if ($c === '') return '';
    return '<a class="chatfab" href="' . h($c) . '" aria-label="Chat met ' . h(st('naam')) . '"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 5.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 3h11A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 20 5.5v8a2.5 2.5 0 0 1-2.5 2.5H10l-4.5 4v-4h0A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 4 14.5z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M8 8.5h8M8 11.5h5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg><span>Chat met ons</span></a>' . "\n";
}
function site_footer() {
    $y = date('Y');
    return '<footer class="foot"><div class="wrap">' . nap_block()
         . '<div class="legal"><span>&copy; ' . $y . ' ' . h(st('naam')) . '</span><span class="logins"><a class="login" href="/admin.php" rel="nofollow">Website beheren</a><a class="login" href="/admin.php?adm" rel="nofollow">Administratie</a></span></div>'
         . '</div></footer>' . "\n" . chat_fab() . whatsapp_fab();
}
/* Blauwe balk onderaan met contactknoppen */
function cta_band($dienstKey = '') {
    $q = $dienstKey !== '' ? '?dienst=' . rawurlencode($dienstKey) : '';
    $out = '<section class="band"><div class="wrap"><div><h2>' . h(st('cta_titel')) . '</h2><p>' . h(st('cta_tekst')) . '</p></div><div class="acts">';
    if (chat_url() !== '') { $out .= '<a class="btn white" href="' . h(chat_url()) . '">Chat direct met ons</a>'; }
    elseif (st('tel') !== '') { $out .= '<a class="btn white" href="tel:' . h(tel_link(st('tel'))) . '">Bel ' . h(st('tel')) . '</a>'; }
    $out .= '<a class="btn outline" href="/contact/' . h($q) . '">Contact opnemen</a></div></div></section>' . "\n";
    return $out;
}

/* ===========================================================
   Voorpagina (index.html)
   =========================================================== */
function project_item($p) {
    $photos = $p['photos'] ?? [];
    return [
        'title' => page_title($p),
        'url'   => '/' . $p['slug'] . '/',
        'desc'  => trim($p['desc'] ?? ''),
        'photo' => !empty($photos) ? photo_url($p['slug'], $photos[0]) : '',
        'date'  => $p['updated'] ?? ($p['created'] ?? ''),
        'cats'  => page_cats($p),
    ];
}
function site_lists($pages) {
    $featured = []; $projects = [];
    foreach ($pages as $p) {
        $folder = page_folder($p);
        if ($folder === '') continue;
        $item = project_item($p);
        $projects[] = $item;
        if ($folder === 'featured') { $featured[] = $item; }
    }
    $sort = function($a, $b) { return strcmp($b['date'], $a['date']); };
    usort($projects, $sort); usort($featured, $sort);
    return [$featured, $projects];
}

/* ===========================================================
   Blokken op de voorpagina: volgorde en aan/uit, plus de nieuwe blokken
   =========================================================== */
$BLOKKEN = ['strook' => 'Balk met diensten', 'diensten' => 'Diensten', 'projecten' => 'Uitgelichte projecten', 'voorna' => 'Voor en na (foto\'s)', 'werkwijze' => 'Werkwijze in stappen', 'cijfers' => 'Cijfers', 'over' => 'Over ons', 'vragen' => 'Veelgestelde vragen', 'reserveren' => 'Afspraakplanner (kalender)', 'aanbod' => 'Aanbod: occasions of producten', 'beoordelingen' => 'Beoordelingen (sterren)', 'menukaart' => 'Menukaart (horeca)', 'beeld1' => 'Eigen afbeelding 1', 'beeld2' => 'Eigen afbeelding 2', 'beeld3' => 'Eigen afbeelding 3', 'beeld4' => 'Eigen afbeelding 4', 'beeld5' => 'Eigen afbeelding 5', 'beeld6' => 'Eigen afbeelding 6'];
$BEELD_VORMEN = ['links' => 'Foto links, tekst rechts', 'rechts' => 'Foto rechts, tekst links', 'breed' => 'Grote foto over de hele breedte', 'klein' => 'Kleine foto in het midden (bijvoorbeeld een logo of keurmerk)'];
function beeld_item($n) {
    global $ST, $BEELD_VORMEN;
    $x = is_array($ST['beelden'][$n] ?? null) ? $ST['beelden'][$n] : [];
    $u = ['foto' => '', 'titel' => '', 'tekst' => '', 'knop' => '', 'link' => '', 'vorm' => 'links', 'van' => '', 'tot' => ''];
    foreach ($u as $k => $v) { if (isset($x[$k]) && is_string($x[$k])) { $u[$k] = $x[$k]; } }
    if (!isset($BEELD_VORMEN[$u['vorm']])) { $u['vorm'] = 'links'; }
    if (!preg_match('/^\d\d-\d\d$/', $u['van']) || !preg_match('/^\d\d-\d\d$/', $u['tot'])) { $u['van'] = ''; $u['tot'] = ''; }
    return $u;
}
function beeld_nu_zichtbaar($x) {
    if ($x['van'] === '') return true;
    $t = date('m-d');
    return $x['van'] <= $x['tot'] ? ($t >= $x['van'] && $t <= $x['tot']) : ($t >= $x['van'] || $t <= $x['tot']);
}
function beeld_datum_tekst($md) {
    $m = ['', 'januari', 'februari', 'maart', 'april', 'mei', 'juni', 'juli', 'augustus', 'september', 'oktober', 'november', 'december'];
    return (int)substr($md, 3, 2) . ' ' . $m[(int)substr($md, 0, 2)];
}
function blokken_volgorde() {
    global $ST, $BLOKKEN;
    $uit = []; $gezien = [];
    foreach ((array)($ST['blokken'] ?? []) as $b) {
        $k = (string)($b['k'] ?? '');
        if (!isset($BLOKKEN[$k]) || isset($gezien[$k])) continue;
        $gezien[$k] = 1; $uit[] = ['k' => $k, 'aan' => !empty($b['aan'])];
    }
    foreach (array_keys($BLOKKEN) as $k) { if (!isset($gezien[$k])) { $uit[] = ['k' => $k, 'aan' => in_array($k, ['strook', 'diensten', 'projecten'], true)]; } }
    return $uit;
}
function blok_lijst($k) { global $ST; return is_array($ST[$k] ?? null) ? $ST[$k] : []; }
function blok_inhoud($k) {
    if ($k === 'voorna') { return array_values(array_filter(blok_lijst('voorna'), function($x) { return ($x['voor'] ?? '') !== '' && ($x['na'] ?? '') !== ''; })); }
    if ($k === 'werkwijze') { return array_values(array_filter(blok_lijst('werkwijze'), function($x) { return trim($x['titel'] ?? '') !== ''; })); }
    if ($k === 'cijfers') { return array_values(array_filter(blok_lijst('cijfers'), function($x) { return trim($x['getal'] ?? '') !== ''; })); }
    if ($k === 'vragen') { return array_values(array_filter(blok_lijst('vragen'), function($x) { return trim($x['vraag'] ?? '') !== '' && trim($x['antwoord'] ?? '') !== ''; })); }
    if ($k === 'over') { return st('over_tekst') !== '' ? [1] : []; }
    if (preg_match('/^beeld([1-6])$/', $k, $m)) { return beeld_item((int)$m[1] - 1)['foto'] !== '' ? [1] : []; }
    if ($k === 'reserveren') { return !empty(res_inst()['aan']) ? [1] : []; }
    if ($k === 'beoordelingen') { return bd_inst()['aan'] && bd_zichtbaar() ? [1] : []; }
    if ($k === 'menukaart') { return mk_inst()['aan'] && mk_aantal(mk_data(), true) ? [1] : []; }
    if ($k === 'aanbod') { return !empty(ab_inst()['aan']) && array_filter(ab_lijst(), function($x) { return ($x['status'] ?? '') !== 'verkocht'; }) ? [1] : []; }
    return [];
}
function blok_kop($titel, $intro) {
    $o = '<div class="head"><div><h2>' . h($titel) . '</h2>';
    if ($intro !== '') { $o .= '<p>' . h($intro) . '</p>'; }
    return $o . '</div></div>';
}
function blok_html($k, $sky) {
    $items = blok_inhoud($k);
    if (!$items) return '';
    $cl = 'section blok-' . $k . ($sky ? ' sky' : '');
    $o = '';
    if ($k === 'voorna') {
        $o .= '<section class="' . $cl . '" id="voor-en-na"><div class="wrap">' . blok_kop(st('voorna_titel') ?: 'Voor en na', st('voorna_intro')) . '<div class="vn-lijst' . (count($items) === 1 ? ' een' : '') . '">';
        foreach ($items as $x) {
            $o .= '<figure class="vn-item"><div class="vn" style="--p:50%"><img src="/uploads/site/' . h(rawurlencode($x['na'])) . '" alt="Na' . (($x['tekst'] ?? '') !== '' ? ': ' . h($x['tekst']) : '') . '" loading="lazy" />'
                . '<div class="vn-voor"><img src="/uploads/site/' . h(rawurlencode($x['voor'])) . '" alt="Voor' . (($x['tekst'] ?? '') !== '' ? ': ' . h($x['tekst']) : '') . '" loading="lazy" /></div>'
                . '<span class="vn-lijn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></span><span class="vn-l vn-l1">Voor</span><span class="vn-l vn-l2">Na</span>'
                . '<input class="vn-schuif" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" aria-label="Schuif tussen voor en na" /></div>';
            if (($x['tekst'] ?? '') !== '') { $o .= '<figcaption>' . h($x['tekst']) . '</figcaption>'; }
            $o .= '</figure>';
        }
        $o .= '</div></div></section>' . "\n";
    } elseif ($k === 'werkwijze') {
        $o .= '<section class="' . $cl . '" id="werkwijze"><div class="wrap">' . blok_kop(st('werkwijze_titel') ?: 'Zo werken wij', st('werkwijze_intro')) . '<ol class="ww-stappen">';
        foreach ($items as $i => $x) { $o .= '<li class="ww-stap"><span class="ww-nr">' . ($i + 1) . '</span><h3>' . h($x['titel']) . '</h3>' . (($x['tekst'] ?? '') !== '' ? '<p>' . h($x['tekst']) . '</p>' : '') . '</li>'; }
        $o .= '</ol></div></section>' . "\n";
    } elseif ($k === 'cijfers') {
        $o .= '<section class="' . $cl . '" id="cijfers"><div class="wrap">' . (st('cijfers_titel') !== '' ? blok_kop(st('cijfers_titel'), '') : '') . '<div class="cf-rij">';
        foreach ($items as $x) { $o .= '<div class="cf"><strong>' . h($x['getal']) . '</strong><span>' . h($x['label'] ?? '') . '</span></div>'; }
        $o .= '</div></div></section>' . "\n";
    } elseif ($k === 'over') {
        $foto = st('over_foto');
        $o .= '<section class="' . $cl . '" id="over-ons"><div class="wrap"><div class="ov' . ($foto === '' ? ' zonder' : '') . '">';
        if ($foto !== '') { $o .= '<div class="ov-foto"><img src="/uploads/site/' . h(rawurlencode($foto)) . '" alt="' . h(st('over_naam') !== '' ? st('over_naam') : st('naam')) . '" loading="lazy" /></div>'; }
        $o .= '<div class="ov-tekst"><h2>' . h(st('over_titel') ?: 'Over ons') . '</h2>';
        foreach (preg_split("/\n\s*\n/", st('over_tekst')) as $al) { $o .= '<p>' . nl2br(h(trim($al))) . '</p>'; }
        if (st('over_naam') !== '') { $o .= '<p class="ov-naam">' . h(st('over_naam')) . '</p>'; }
        $o .= '</div></div></div></section>' . "\n";
    } elseif ($k === 'beoordelingen') {
        $o .= bd_blok_html($sky);
    } elseif ($k === 'aanbod') {
        $o .= ab_blok_html($sky);
    } elseif ($k === 'menukaart') {
        $o .= mk_blok_html($sky);
    } elseif ($k === 'reserveren') {
        $ri = res_inst();
        $o .= '<section class="' . $cl . '" id="reserveren"><div class="wrap">' . blok_kop($ri['titel'] !== '' ? $ri['titel'] : 'Reserveren', $ri['intro']) . res_widget($ri) . '</div></section>' . "\n";
    } elseif (preg_match('/^beeld([1-6])$/', $k, $m)) {
        $x = beeld_item((int)$m[1] - 1);
        $id = 'beeld-' . $m[1];
        $per = $x['van'] !== '';
        $txt = '';
        if ($x['titel'] !== '') { $txt .= '<h2>' . h($x['titel']) . '</h2>'; }
        if ($x['tekst'] !== '') { foreach (preg_split("/\n\s*\n/", $x['tekst']) as $al) { $txt .= '<p>' . nl2br(h(trim($al))) . '</p>'; } }
        if ($x['knop'] !== '') { $txt .= '<p class="bd-knop"><a class="btn primary" href="' . h($x['link'] !== '' ? $x['link'] : '/contact/') . '">' . h($x['knop']) . '</a></p>'; }
        $img = '<div class="bd-foto"><img src="/uploads/site/' . h(rawurlencode($x['foto'])) . '" alt="' . h($x['titel'] !== '' ? $x['titel'] : st('naam')) . '" loading="lazy" /></div>';
        $vorm = $x['vorm'];
        if ($txt === '' && ($vorm === 'links' || $vorm === 'rechts')) { $vorm = 'solo'; }
        $o .= '<section class="' . $cl . ' blok-beeld" id="' . $id . '"' . ($per ? ' hidden data-van="' . h($x['van']) . '" data-tot="' . h($x['tot']) . '"' : '') . '><div class="wrap"><div class="bd ' . $vorm . '">';
        $t = $txt !== '' ? '<div class="bd-tekst">' . $txt . '</div>' : '';
        $o .= $vorm === 'breed' ? $t . $img : $img . $t;
        $o .= '</div></div></section>' . "\n";
        if ($per) { $o .= '<script>(function(){var e=document.getElementById("' . $id . '");if(!e)return;var d=new Date(),t=("0"+(d.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2)+"-"+("0"+d.getDate()).slice(-2),a=e.getAttribute("data-van"),b=e.getAttribute("data-tot");if(a<=b?(t>=a&&t<=b):(t>=a||t<=b)){e.hidden=false;}})();</script>' . "\n"; }
    } elseif ($k === 'vragen') {
        $o .= '<section class="' . $cl . '" id="vragen"><div class="wrap">' . blok_kop(st('vragen_titel') ?: 'Veelgestelde vragen', '') . '<div class="fq">';
        foreach ($items as $x) { $o .= '<details class="fq-item"><summary>' . h($x['vraag']) . '</summary><div class="fq-a">' . nl2br(h($x['antwoord'])) . '</div></details>'; }
        $o .= '</div></div></section>' . "\n";
    }
    return $o;
}
function blokken_jsonld() {
    foreach (blokken_volgorde() as $b) {
        if ($b['k'] !== 'vragen' || !$b['aan']) continue;
        $v = blok_inhoud('vragen');
        if (!$v) return '';
        $ld = ['@context' => 'https://schema.org', '@type' => 'FAQPage', 'mainEntity' => array_map(function($x) { return ['@type' => 'Question', 'name' => $x['vraag'], 'acceptedAnswer' => ['@type' => 'Answer', 'text' => $x['antwoord']]]; }, $v)];
        return "\n" . '<script type="application/ld+json">' . json_encode($ld, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_HEX_TAG) . '</script>';
    }
    return '';
}

    foreach (blokken_volgorde() as $blok) {
        if (!$blok['aan']) continue;
        $k = $blok['k'];
        if ($k === 'strook') {
            if (empty(services())) continue;
            $out .= '<div class="servicebar" aria-hidden="true"><div class="wrap">';
            foreach (services() as $s) { $out .= '<span>' . h($s['naam']) . '</span>'; }
            for ($kopie = 0; $kopie < 3; $kopie++) { foreach (services() as $s) { $out .= '<span class="ff-dup">' . h($s['naam']) . '</span>'; } }
            $out .= '</div></div>' . "\n";
        } elseif ($k === 'diensten') {
            if (empty(services())) continue;
            $out .= '<section class="section' . ($sky ? ' sky' : '') . '" id="diensten"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><div><h2>' . h(st('diensten_titel')) . '</h2>';
            if (st('diensten_intro') !== '') $out .= '<p>' . h(st('diensten_intro')) . '</p>';
            $out .= '</div></div><div class="services" id="services"></div></div></section>' . "\n";
            $sky = !$sky;
        } elseif ($k === 'projecten') {
            if (empty($featured)) continue;
            $out .= '<section class="section' . ($sky ? ' sky' : '') . '" id="featuredSection" hidden><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><div><h2>Uitgelichte ' . h(werk_woord()[1]) . '</h2><p>Een greep uit ons werk.</p></div><a class="textlink" href="#projecten">Alle ' . h(werk_woord()[1]) . ' bekijken</a></div><div class="folders" id="featured"></div></div></section>' . "\n";
            $sky = !$sky;
        } else {
            $b = blok_html($k, $sky);
            if ($b !== '') { $out .= $b; $sky = !$sky; }
        }
    }
    $out .= cta_band() . '</main>' . "\n";

    $out .= '<main id="projects" class="view" hidden><section class="crumb"><div class="wrap">';
    $out .= '<a class="backlink" href="/" data-go="home"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 12H5M11 18l-6-6 6-6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>Terug naar home</a>';
    $out .= '<h1><span id="projTitle">' . h(werk_hoofd(werk_woord()[1])) . '</span> <span class="count" id="projCount">0</span></h1><p id="projLead"></p><nav class="filters" id="filters" aria-label="Filter op dienst"></nav></div></section>';
    $out .= '<section class="section sky"><div class="wrap"><div class="cards" id="cards"></div></div></section></main>' . "\n";

    $out .= site_footer();
    $js = <<<'JS'
<script>
(function () {
  var CFG = __DATA__;
  var SERVICES = CFG.services || [];
  var data = { featured: CFG.featured || [], projects: CFG.projects || [] };
  var arrow = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  }
  function serviceByKey(k) {
    for (var i = 0; i < SERVICES.length; i++) { if (SERVICES[i].key === k) { return SERVICES[i]; } }
    return null;
  }
  function countFor(k) {
    return data.projects.filter(function (p) { return (p.cats || []).indexOf(k) !== -1; }).length;
  }

  function renderServices() {
    var box = document.getElementById("services");
    if (!box) { return; }
    box.innerHTML = SERVICES.map(function (s, i) {
      var n = countFor(s.key);
      return '<a class="service" href="' + esc(s.page) + '"><span class="num">' + ("0" + (i + 1)).slice(-2) + '</span>' +
        '<h3>' + esc(s.name) + '</h3><p>' + esc(s.text) + '</p>' +
        '<span class="go">Meer informatie' + (n ? ' <span class="n">(' + n + (n === 1 ? ' ' + CFG.we : ' ' + CFG.wm) + ')</span>' : '') + ' ' + arrow + '</span></a>';
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderFeatured() {
    var featured = data.featured.slice(0, 2);
    var sec = document.getElementById("featuredSection");
    var box = document.getElementById("featured");
    if (!sec || !box) { return; }
    if (!featured.length) { sec.hidden = true; return; }
    sec.hidden = false;
    box.className = "folders" + (featured.length === 1 ? " single" : "");
    box.innerHTML = featured.map(function (p, i) {
      var sheet = p.photo
        ? '<div class="photo-sheet" aria-hidden="true"><img src="' + esc(p.photo) + '" alt="" loading="lazy" /></div>'
        : '<div class="photo-sheet empty" aria-hidden="true">Nog geen foto</div>';
      return '<a class="folder ' + (i === 0 ? "a" : "b") + '" href="' + esc(p.url) + '">' +
        '<span class="tab" aria-hidden="true"></span><div class="body">' + sheet +
        '<div class="front"><h3>' + esc(p.title) + '</h3>' +
        (p.desc ? '<p class="desc">' + esc(p.desc) + '</p>' : '') +
        '<div class="meta"><span class="open">Bekijk ' + esc(CFG.we) + ' ' + arrow + '</span></div></div></div></a>';
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderProjects(cat) {
    var s = cat ? serviceByKey(cat) : null;
    if (cat && !s) { cat = ""; }
    var list = data.projects.filter(function (p) { return !cat || (p.cats || []).indexOf(cat) !== -1; });
    document.getElementById("projTitle").textContent = s ? s.name : CFG.wm.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + CFG.wm.slice(1);
    document.getElementById("projLead").textContent = s ? s.text : "Een overzicht van ons werk. Kies er een voor de foto's en het verhaal.";
    document.getElementById("projCount").textContent = list.length;
    document.getElementById("filters").innerHTML = SERVICES.length ?
      '<a href="#projecten"' + (!cat ? ' class="on" aria-current="true"' : '') + '>Alle ' + esc(CFG.wm) + '</a>' +
      SERVICES.map(function (x) {
        return '<a href="#projecten/' + esc(x.key) + '"' + (x.key === cat ? ' class="on" aria-current="true"' : '') + '>' + esc(x.name) + '</a>';
      }).join("") : "";
    document.getElementById("cards").innerHTML = list.length ? list.map(function (p) {
      var tags = (p.cats || []).map(serviceByKey).filter(Boolean).map(function (x) { return '<span>' + esc(x.name) + '</span>'; }).join("");
      return '<a class="card" href="' + esc(p.url) + '"><div class="img">' +
        (p.photo ? '<img src="' + esc(p.photo) + '" alt="" loading="lazy" />' : '') +
        '</div><div class="txt">' + (tags ? '<div class="tags">' + tags + '</div>' : '') +
        '<h3>' + esc(p.title) + '</h3><p>' + esc(p.desc || "") +
        '</p><span class="go">Bekijk ' + esc(CFG.we) + ' ' + arrow + '</span></div></a>';
    }).join("") : '<p class="empty">' + (cat ? "Er staan nog geen projecten in deze categorie. Binnenkort meer." : "Er zijn nog geen projecten gepubliceerd.") + '</p>';
  }

  function route() {
    var h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash || "");
    var onProjects = h === "#projecten" || h.indexOf("#projecten/") === 0;
    document.getElementById("home").hidden = onProjects;
    document.getElementById("projects").hidden = !onProjects;
    if (onProjects) {
      var cat = h.length > 11 ? h.slice(11) : "";
      renderProjects(cat);
      var s = serviceByKey(cat);
      document.title = (s ? s.name + " - " : CFG.wm.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + CFG.wm.slice(1) + " - ") + CFG.naam;
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    } else {
      document.title = CFG.title;
      var el = h.length > 1 ? document.getElementById(h.slice(1)) : null;
      if (el) { el.scrollIntoView(); } else { window.scrollTo(0, 0); }
    }
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-go="home"]').forEach(function (a) {
    a.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (location.hash) { history.pushState("", document.title, location.pathname + location.search); }
      route();
    });
  });
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", route);
  window.addEventListener("popstate", route);

  document.querySelectorAll(".vn").forEach(function (v) {
    var r = v.querySelector(".vn-schuif");
    if (!r) { return; }
    var zet = function () { v.style.setProperty("--p", r.value + "%"); };
    r.addEventListener("input", zet); zet();
  });
  renderServices();
  renderFeatured();
  route();
})();
</script>
JS;
    $out .= str_replace('__DATA__', $json, $js) . "\n</body>\n</html>\n";
    return $out;
}

/* ===========================================================
   Dienstpagina
   =========================================================== */
function render_service_page($key, $pages) {
    $all = services();
    $s = $all[$key];
    $name = $s['naam'];
    $intro = trim($s['kort'] ?? '');
    $titel = $name . (st('plaats') !== '' ? ' in ' . st('plaats') . (st('werkgebied') !== '' ? ' en omgeving' : '') : '');
    $meta = cut($name . ' door ' . st('naam') . (st('plaats') !== '' ? ' uit ' . st('plaats') : '') . '. ' . ($intro !== '' ? $intro . ' ' : '') . (st('werkgebied') !== '' ? 'Werkgebied: ' . st('werkgebied') . '.' : ''), 160);
    $svcLd = [
        '@context' => 'https://schema.org', '@type' => 'Service', 'name' => $name, 'serviceType' => $name,
        'description' => $meta, 'url' => site_url() . '/' . $s['slug'] . '/', 'provider' => ['@id' => site_url() . '/#bedrijf'],
    ];
    if (st('werkgebied') !== '') $svcLd['areaServed'] = st('werkgebied');
    $extra = business_jsonld() . "\n" . '<script type="application/ld+json">' . json_encode($svcLd, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_HEX_TAG) . '</script>';
    $out = site_head($titel . ' | ' . st('naam'), $meta, '/' . $s['slug'] . '/', $extra, true);
    $out .= <<<'CSS'
<style>
  .shero { background:var(--navy); color:#fff; padding:clamp(48px,7vw,96px) 0 clamp(44px,6vw,80px); }
  .shero .eyebrow { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(255,255,255,.7); margin-bottom:18px; }
  .shero .eyebrow::before { content:""; width:28px; height:3px; border-radius:3px; background:var(--stripe); }
  .shero h1 { font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,62px); max-width:20ch; }
  .shero p { margin:18px 0 0; color:rgba(255,255,255,.8); max-width:56ch; font-size:19px; }
  .shero .acts { margin-top:30px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; }
  .sbody { padding:clamp(48px,7vw,88px) 0; }
  .stext { max-width:68ch; font-size:17.5px; }
  .stext p { margin:0 0 1.1em; }
  .sec { padding:clamp(48px,7vw,88px) 0; }
  .sec.sky { background:var(--sky); }
  .sec h2 { font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,42px); line-height:1.1; margin:0 0 28px; }
  .others { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; }
  .others a { text-decoration:none; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:999px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); background:#fff; }
  .others a:hover { border-color:var(--blue); color:var(--blue); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
CSS;
    $out .= site_header('/#diensten', 'Alle diensten');
    $out .= '<section class="shero"><div class="wrap">';
    if (st('eyebrow') !== '') $out .= '<div class="eyebrow">' . h(st('eyebrow')) . '</div>';
    $out .= '<h1>' . h($titel) . '</h1>';
    if ($intro !== '') $out .= '<p>' . h($intro) . '</p>';
    $out .= '<div class="acts"><a class="btn primary" href="/contact/?dienst=' . h(rawurlencode($key)) . '">Contact opnemen</a>';
    if (st('tel') !== '') $out .= '<a class="btn quiet" href="tel:' . h(tel_link(st('tel'))) . '">Bel ' . h(st('tel')) . '</a>';
    if (chat_url() !== '') $out .= '<a class="btn quiet" href="' . h(chat_url()) . '">Chat met ons</a>';
    $out .= '</div></div></section>';

    $out .= '<main>';
    $paras = paragraphs($s['tekst'] ?? '');
    if (!empty($paras)) {
        $out .= '<section class="sbody"><div class="wrap"><div class="stext">';
        foreach ($paras as $para) { $out .= '<p>' . nl2br(h($para)) . '</p>'; }
        $out .= '</div></div></section>';
    }

    $list = [];
    foreach ($pages as $p) {
        if (page_folder($p) === '') continue;
        if (!in_array($key, page_cats($p), true)) continue;
        $list[] = $p;
    }
    usort($list, function($a, $b) { return strcmp($b['updated'] ?? ($b['created'] ?? ''), $a['updated'] ?? ($a['created'] ?? '')); });
    $out .= '<section class="sec sky"><div class="wrap"><h2>Projecten: ' . h($name) . '</h2>';
    if (empty($list)) {
        $out .= '<p class="empty">Hier verschijnen binnenkort onze projecten.</p>';
    } else {
        $out .= '<div class="cards">';
        foreach ($list as $p) {
            $t = page_title($p);
            $photos = $p['photos'] ?? [];
            $img = !empty($photos) ? '<img src="' . h(photo_url($p['slug'], $photos[0])) . '" alt="' . h($t) . '" loading="lazy" />' : '';
            $out .= '<a class="card" href="/' . h($p['slug']) . '/"><div class="img">' . $img . '</div><div class="txt"><h3>' . h($t) . '</h3>';
            if (trim($p['desc'] ?? '') !== '') { $out .= '<p>' . h($p['desc']) . '</p>'; }
            $out .= '</div></a>';
        }
        $out .= '</div>';
    }
    $out .= '</div></section>';

    if (count($all) > 1) {
        $out .= '<section class="sec"><div class="wrap"><h2>Andere diensten</h2><div class="others">';
        foreach ($all as $k => $x) {
            if ($k === $key) continue;
            $out .= '<a href="' . h(service_url($k)) . '">' . h($x['naam']) . '</a>';
        }
        $out .= '</div></div></section>';
    }
    $out .= '</main>' . cta_band($key) . site_footer() . "\n</body>\n</html>\n";
    return $out;
}

<style>

        $out .= '<input type="hidden" name="dienst" value="anders" />';
